name: Moonlit Lab
introDiscord: Beneath the Moonreef Sovereign's throne, the hidden passage descends into something that does not belong in the reef. A breached human annex hums beneath artificial moonlight. Cracked containment glass, drowned research stations, and warning symbols disappear beneath coral that has spent years reclaiming the facility.
introTwitch: Beneath the Moonreef Sovereign's throne, the hidden passage descends into something that does not belong in the reef. A breached human annex hums beneath artificial moonlight. Cracked containment glass, drowned research stations, and warning symbols disappear beneath coral that has spent years reclaiming the facility.

breached-observation-wing.prompt: Cold false moonlight flickers through cracked observation chambers. Coral grows through overturned desks, warning lamps blink without purpose, and three old routes split beneath cameras that still attempt to follow movement.

left.message: A security operative steps from behind the fractured glass. Its old uniform is immaculate despite the ruined room. Whatever keeps the Moonlit Grunt moving, it still remembers how to identify an intruder.

right.message: A serious emergency locker has acquired an enormous paper mustache. Beneath it Shizuki wrote: "Official security disguise. Worked perfectly. Do not ask security." Inside are Star Candies.

forward.message: Behind an overturned desk, old escape tallies have been covered by a newer doodle of an elf kicking open the laboratory door. One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's note: "Came back later. Door still deserved it."

specimen-transfer-halls.prompt: The next corridors are disturbingly intact. Transport rails cross overhead, sealed chambers line the walls, and dormant machinery wakes one piece at a time as you pass.

left.message: A damaged recovery chamber still has one cycle remaining. Shizuki scratched into the casing: "Works perfectly. Makes everything taste like metal. Yes, somehow even thoughts."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki added beneath it: "Already healthy? Show-off. Save the horrible metal thoughts for later."

right.message: Ceiling rails lock into place. An old insignia lights blue. A Moonlit Grunt advances from between the sealed chambers without saying a word.

forward.message:
A terminal displays exactly one readable filename:

NOT_SHIZUKI_AGAIN.txt

Opening it produces a smiling face and the message:

'Check under the keyboard. You're welcome.'

There are Star Candies beneath the keyboard.

sealed-administration-sector.prompt: Corrupted files flicker across abandoned desks while three sealed passages respond to your approach. Most records are unreadable now. Shizuki appears to have improved several of the surviving researcher portraits.

left.message: A stern portrait has acquired a magnificent fake mustache, eyebrows, and what may be cat ears. Beneath it Shizuki wrote: "Designed the locks. Couldn't design a personality. Take the emergency fund." You recover Star Candies.

right.message: A maintenance compartment contains a renewed field kit beside an old hiding place. Shizuki's newer note reads: "Used this spot when I was escaping. Now I hide snacks here because nobody improved security. Much better memory."
right.fullHpMessage: A tiny arrow beneath the note adds: "No injuries? Excellent. Annoy security responsibly."

forward.message: The final facility insignia flares beneath the coral. A Moonlit Grunt turns from an observation window and raises its weapon with practiced precision.

boss-antechamber.name: Moonlit Lab Courtyard
boss-antechamber.prompt: Sealed doors open onto an artificial outdoors. Silver trees rise from stone planters, cables knot through their roots, and coral now grows over human insignias beneath a false moon. Observation windows surround a courtyard designed to imitate freedom inside a place that never offered any.

bossPromptDiscord:
The doors seal behind you.

The false moon flickers awake over the silver trees.

A uniformed figure waits in the courtyard with one hand resting on an old facility weapon.

Its voice cuts through the annex:

'This facility remains under active authority. State your authorization.'

The answer Shizuki left scratched into the nearest planter is much shorter:

'No.'

A powerful Officer blocks the courtyard.

Use /yes to continue or /no to withdraw for now.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Moonlit Lab Courtyard. The false moon dims behind you, but the warning sirens continue counting as though the facility still believes someone is coming back.

boss.revealText:
The courtyard alarms speak with a voice unused for years:

'Moonlit Officer authorization restored.'

The figure draws its weapon as the false moon burns white overhead.

Moonlit Officer appears.

completionText:
The Moonlit Officer falls silent.

For several seconds, the annex waits for another command that never comes.

Then the false moon flickers.

One light goes dark.

Then another.

Coral shifts through the cracked courtyard stones while the Lunar Current finally reaches places the facility had kept sealed.

Pinned over the old insignia is one final newer note from Shizuki:

'If you're reading this, you beat the Officer. Nice! I come back sometimes to rearrange the warning signs. It REALLY hates that.

This place used to decide where I could go.

Now I decide when I visit.

Much better arrangement.

Keep going~'

Moonlit Reef's final Adventure is complete.

But among the surviving records is one map showing a route farther into the Astral Sea.

The journey does not end here.
